title: A template kit names a link's label slot only in links[].labelId; a link that shows words with neither a label slot nor a fixed-text reason fails linksWithoutLabel
steps: S1: From the checkout (no stand, no site, no browser) run: node --test --test-concurrency=1 packages/cms/tracy-quickstart-tools/test/template-kit-link-label-reasons.test.mjs packages/cms/tracy-quickstart-tools/test/template-kit-coverage-gate.test.mjs
S2: Read the summary lines `pass` and `fail`.
expect: `a phone link names its block slot: words without a letter pick only a slot of the block` passes.
`the check counts a link with words and neither a label slot nor a reason, and a label slot outside its block` passes.
`relabel drops every labelOf copy, and a settled kit passes the check` passes.
`a link label owned by another block is listed in the link block as a reference, never a second owner` passes (no labelOf in the gate's output).
evidence: JA Boxing 1.0.10 kit before the fix: 254 links with labelId, 80 of them in no slot's labelOf; 3 phone links named no slot. After relabel: 257 with labelId, 135 with fixedLabel, linksWithoutLabel 0, image digest equal to the approval.
